content.title: BlackRock Joins Marriott in Getting Caught Up in Sonder Collapse
content.summary: The company’s bankruptcy has already dealt a blow to Marriott International Inc., which made Sonder hotels bookable on its website and app in an ill-fated bid to add rooms to its global network.  Marriott provided funding to “critical short-term obligations” the day before it terminated the licensing agreement, according to a court filing on Friday.  Several entities under BlackRock, including BlackRock Global Allocation Fund and BlackRock Global Long/Short Credit Fund were listed as creditors.
